claim.scope: Confidence in the disputed handoff claim or feature; the mapping gives no quantitative confidence adjustment.

provenance.rationale: The span states the confidence consequence and locates the dispute at the handoff.

signal_basis.value: Independently grounded sources disagree about the same equipment, booking and handoff, with source access and dependence assessed and conflicting timestamps, definitions and identities examined without forcing agreement.
signal_basis.scope: Contradictions bearing on the specific disputed feature, with unresolved contradictions retained as a reason to withhold treating that feature as established.

provenance.rationale: The cited spans establish the disagreement signal, source assessment, reconciliation procedure and limit on treating disputed features as established.
The bounded confidence inference is supported without an additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Relevant contradictions surviving the stated source and reference checks weaken evidential support for the disputed feature. This licenses reduced confidence without establishing that the feature is false or identifying the cause of lateness.
uncertainty: The mapping does not determine the magnitude of the confidence reduction or which conflicting account is correct.
